titulo.alumno: Describing two occupations with かたわら

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it adds in context.

palabras.significado: book; written work (part of a compound)

piezas.titulo: かたわら introduces a secondary activity carried out alongside the main occupation.
texto: It is usually associated with stable activities and written style. It is not the normal link for two brief simultaneous actions.
大学 で 教える かたわら、専門 書 の 翻訳 も しています。 (Besides teaching at university, they also translate specialized books.)
会社 を 経営 する かたわら、地域 の 子ども に 音楽 を 教えて います。 (Besides running a company, they teach music to children in the community.)
